properties.notes: Site occupied by industrial/commercial uses to the west of the town centre. The existing businesses would require relocation prior to any redevelopment taking place and clearance of the extant buildings would also be required. No timescale is in place for this or recent indication that it is being considered. The current availability of the site is uncertain. There still may be potential in the long-term but no residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
